body:
I use oxycodone fairly frequently. Normally I will crush up the pill and snort it, removing the time coating when necessary. The thing that I am wondering is why every experience I have read describes a mellow euphoric high. My high couldn't be farther from that. After I snort an oxy, about 10 min later, I get jacked up. I personally want to compare it to meth, but able to go to sleep whenever I chose. I clean, put together models, search on the computer endlessly.
